decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of excessive footprint, limited plot size and siting, would constitute as an overdevelopment of the site. It would fail to respect the prevailing character of the surrounding area would not be of a scale suitable to the function of the location contrary to Policies 7, 9 and 18 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The proposed development, by reasons of its location on a constrained site and poor design quality appears as an incompatible development which is out of context with the surrounding development. As such, the proposal is unacceptable in design terms, contrary to the principles of sustainable development of the National Planning Policy Framework, Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021, Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018, and the Council's adopted Supplementary Planning Document 14: Creating Locally Distinctive Places.

Without evidence to the contrary, the development has failed to demonstrate a satisfactory flood risk and site drainage strategy and water efficiency calculations in compliance with Policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies 32 and 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Due to the insufficent internal floor area, floor to ceiling height and lack of privacy to the rear garden, the proposal is considered to result in poor quality of amenity for the future occupants and fails to meet the objectives set out in Policy D6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 9 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Without evidence to the contrary, it has not been demonstrated that there would be no adverse impacts on the amenity of future occupiers from the potential effects on the proposed dwelling from the surrounding commercial activities. The proposal is therefore considered to fail to comply with the aims set out in Policies 29 and 34 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
